title: melodic
description: Multivariate Exploratory Linear Optimised Decomposition into Independent Components

input_file.description: Input file names (either single file name or comma-separated list or text file)
input_file.title: Input file

mask_file.description: File name of mask for thresholding
mask_file.title: Mask file

dimensionality_reduction.description: Dimensionality reduction into specified number of dimensions (default is automatic estimation)
dimensionality_reduction.title: Dimensionality reduction

cifti_io.description: Input/output as CIFTI (warning: auto-dimensionality estimation for CIFTI data is currently inaccurate)
cifti_io.title: CIFTI input/output

dimest_technique.description: Use specific dimensionality estimation technique: lap, bic, mdl, aic, mean (default: lap)
dimest_technique.title: Dimensionality estimation technique

separate_variance_normalization.description: Switch on separate variance normalization for each input dataset (off by default)
separate_variance_normalization.title: Separate variance normalization

disable_migp.description: Switch off MIGP data reduction when using -a concat (full temporal concatenation will be used)
disable_migp.title: Disable MIGP

migp_factor.description: Internal Factor of mem-threshold relative to number of Eigenmaps (default: 2)
migp_factor.title: MIGP factor

num_ics.description: Number of ICs to extract (for deflation approach)
num_ics.title: Number of ICs

covar_weights.description: Voxel-wise weights for the covariance matrix (e.g. segmentation information)
covar_weights.title: Covariance weights

eps_rank1_error.description: Minimum error change for rank-1 approximation in TICA
eps_rank1_error.title: Minimum rank-1 error change

max_iters.description: Maximum number of iterations before restart
max_iters.title: Max iterations

mm_threshold.description: Threshold for Mixture Model based inference
mm_threshold.title: Mixture Model threshold

no_mixture_modeling.description: Switch off mixture modeling on IC maps
no_mixture_modeling.title: No mixture modeling

ic_components_file.description: Input filename of the IC components file for mixture modeling
ic_components_file.title: IC components file

mixing_matrix_file.description: Input filename of mixing matrix for mixture modeling / filtering
mixing_matrix_file.title: Mixing matrix file

session_modes_file.description: Input filename of matrix of session modes for report generation
session_modes_file.title: Session modes file

component_filter.description: List of component numbers to remove
component_filter.title: Component filter

background_image.description: Specify background image for report (default: mean image)
background_image.title: Background image

log_power_calc.description: Calculate log of power for frequency spectrum
log_power_calc.title: Log power calculation

output_stats.description: Output thresholded maps and probability maps
output_stats.title: Output thresholded and probability maps

report_maps.description: Control string for spatial map images (see slicer)
report_maps.title: Report maps control
